stable_traits.personality: Determined, fearful of his power, protective of others

characters.notes: Revealed as the Dragon Reborn. Wields the heron-mark blade, has used the One Power (saidin) and fears doing so again. Plans to leave and go somewhere alone.

stable_traits.physical_traits: Wears red wild-roses in her hair

characters.notes: Going to Tar Valon for training as an Aes Sedai. Speaks with Rand about his plans.
Training Rand with the sword. Avoids speaking to Nynaeve though looks at her.

stable_traits.filiations: Raised in the Royal Palace in Cairhien

characters.notes: Recovering from injuries, carried on a litter. Possesses the Horn of Valere and pieces of a seal. Uses a listening stone (angreal or ter'angreal). Knows Rand is the Dragon Reborn.
Going to Tar Valon for training. Avoids Lan's gaze while he looks at her when she's not looking.

stable_traits.physical_traits: Broad face, long eyebrows, tufted ears
stable_traits.filiations: Son of Arent son of Halan
stable_traits.personality: Gentle, devoted to trees and growing things

characters.notes: Sang a Tree Song over the Green Man's oak to preserve it from the Blight. Carries the golden chest containing the Horn of Valere.
Still needs Healing from the taint of the dagger. Going to Tar Valon. His father wants to see him.
Bringing up the rear with his axe. Wants to see Tar Valon before going elsewhere.
Dead. Buried beneath an oak in his garden. His presence still fights to hold life in the oak and surrounding area.
Troubled by what he saw at Tarwin's Gap - a man doing impossible things. Holds Padan Fain as prisoner per Moiraine's command.

stable_traits.personality: Duty-bound, regretful at missing the battle

characters.notes: Arrived too late to see the miracle at Tarwin's Gap, which troubles him greatly.
Held prisoner in Fal Dara. Alternates between whining at guards and trying to command them. Moiraine wants to speak with him when rested.
Carries part of the litter for Moiraine, along with Aldieb.
Moiraine's horse. Carries part of the litter and has Lews Therin's banner in the blanketroll tied to her saddle.
Rand's horse.
Not present in chapter but referenced by Rand who wants him to be proud and considers him 'my father' despite learning otherwise.
Historical figure. His banner is kept wrapped in Moiraine's blanketroll.

factions.name: The Shadow
factions.notes: The Dark One or his primary agent

characters.notes: Not present but referenced in context of the strike against 'the Dark One' and the Shadow recovering.

appearances.whereabouts: Green Man's garden at dawn, then traveling south from the Blight through the Border to Fal Dara, then on a balcony in Fal Dara keep seven days later
appearances.notable_actions: Rides out of the Blight with the group. Observes the towers at the lakes. Trains with the heron-mark sword under Lan's instruction. Tells Egwene he is leaving and will not return home. Internally struggles with being able to channel and fears hurting others.
appearances.demeanor: Conflicted, fearful, determined to leave, grief-stricken about his identity and power

appearances.whereabouts: Traveling from the Blight to Fal Dara, then speaking with Rand on a balcony at Fal Dara keep
appearances.notable_actions: Mounts Bela. Helps Moiraine set wards. Wears red wild-roses in her hair. Speaks with Rand about his plans and tries to convince him to come to Tar Valon.
appearances.demeanor: Concerned, caring, hopeful but worried about Rand's plans

appearances.whereabouts: Leading the group from the Blight to Fal Dara, then training Rand on a balcony at Fal Dara keep
appearances.notable_actions: Fashions a litter for Moiraine. Chooses campsite. Trains Rand in swordsmanship. Watches Nynaeve but will not speak to her. Tells Loial he is a good man. Responds to watchmen about King Easar.
appearances.demeanor: Stoic, watchful, conflicted about Nynaeve, supportive of Rand's choice

appearances.whereabouts: On a litter traveling from the Blight to Fal Dara, then in Agelmar's study, then in Agelmar's private garden
appearances.notable_actions: Sets wards with Nynaeve and Egwene. Gives orders about Padan Fain. Reveals the Horn of Valere to Agelmar and orders it sent to Illian. Keeps Lews Therin's banner hidden. Uses a listening stone to eavesdrop on Rand and Egwene. Declares Rand is the Dragon Reborn.
appearances.demeanor: Weak physically but commanding in presence, strategic, secretive, satisfied

appearances.whereabouts: Traveling from the Blight to Fal Dara, riding beside Moiraine's litter
appearances.notable_actions: Rides beside the litter holding Aldieb's reins. Helps Moiraine set wards. Drops her eyes when Lan looks at her.
appearances.demeanor: Conflicted, avoiding Lan's gaze, learning from Moiraine

appearances.whereabouts: Traveling from the Blight to Fal Dara, then in Agelmar's study
appearances.notable_actions: Sings a Tree Song to preserve the Green Man's oak from the Blight. Carries the golden chest with the Horn of Valere. Opens the chest to show Agelmar the Horn.
appearances.demeanor: Sorrowful about the Green Man, satisfied with his song's success, abashed about his singing

appearances.whereabouts: Traveling from the Blight to Fal Dara, riding behind Lan with his bow
appearances.notable_actions: Rides with bow ready. Asks Moiraine what they did to strike the blow against the Dark One.
appearances.demeanor: Curious, ready for combat if needed

appearances.whereabouts: Traveling from the Blight to Fal Dara, bringing up the rear with his axe
appearances.notable_actions: Brings up the rear with axe ready. Asks why the Blight feels different. Stares at the new growth in wonder.
appearances.demeanor: Observant, wondering, ready for combat if needed

appearances.whereabouts: Buried beneath an oak in his garden
appearances.notable_actions: None (dead), but his presence/remnant helps the oak retain leaves and preserve a small area from the Blight

appearances.whereabouts: Fal Dara keep, in his study and presumably throughout the city during celebrations
appearances.notable_actions: Meets with Moiraine's party. Describes the victory at Tarwin's Gap. Expresses trouble about seeing 'a man' do impossible things. Holds Padan Fain prisoner. Gasps at seeing the Horn of Valere and offers to march to Shayol Ghul with it, but accepts Moiraine's order to send it to Illian.
appearances.demeanor: Troubled, awed, dutiful, conflicted about what he witnessed

appearances.whereabouts: Fal Dara keep, greeting the party and attending Agelmar
appearances.notable_actions: Greets the party. Regrets arriving too late to see the miracle at Tarwin's Gap. Follows Moiraine's commands despite initial protest. Dismisses servants from Agelmar's study.
appearances.demeanor: Sour, grim, regretful, dutiful despite grief

appearances.notable_actions: Whines at guards and tries to command them

appearances.whereabouts: Traveling from the Blight to Fal Dara, carrying part of Moiraine's litter
appearances.notable_actions: Carries part of the litter with Aldieb

appearances.whereabouts: Traveling from the Blight to Fal Dara, carrying part of Moiraine's litter
appearances.notable_actions: Carries part of the litter with Bela. Has Lews Therin's banner in blanketroll on her saddle. Led away by a groom with strict orders about the blanketroll.

appearances.whereabouts: Traveling from the Blight to Fal Dara, carrying Rand
appearances.notable_actions: Carries Rand. Receives a garland of morningstars from a soldier.

relationships.description: Moiraine holds the Warder bond with Lan, who serves as her Warder
Mutual romantic tension; they avoid speaking but watch each other when the other is not looking
Lan trains Rand in swordsmanship and blademaster techniques
Romantic relationship that is troubled by Rand's plans to leave and Egwene's departure for Tar Valon
Father-son relationship (adoptive); Rand wants Tam to be proud of him and still considers him his father
Moiraine has guided/manipulated Rand's journey; she avoids direct contact with him now but secretly monitors him and knows he is the Dragon Reborn
Moiraine is teaching Egwene (and Nynaeve) about channeling and wards
Moiraine is teaching Nynaeve about channeling and wards
Moiraine commands Agelmar who defers to her authority as Aes Sedai, though he is troubled by recent events
Ingtar serves under Agelmar as a military officer in Fal Dara
Loial revered the Green Man as Treebrother and sang to preserve his memory and the oak above his grave
